```{r}
# Helper function to calculate ppm difference
ppm_diff <- function(mz1, mz2) {
  abs(mz1 - mz2) / mz1 * 1e6
}

align_features <- function(df1, df2, best_match = FALSE) {
  aligned <- list()
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(df1))) {
    row1 <- df1[i, ]
    candidates <- df2[
      ppm_diff(row1$mz, df2$mz) < 5 &
      abs(row1$rt - df2$rt) < 0.2, 
    ]
    if (!is.na(row1$identity)) {
      candidates <- candidates[
        !is.na(candidates$identity) &
        candidates$identity == row1$identity &
        candidates$ion == row1$ion &
        candidates$formula == row1$formula, 
      ]
    }
    if (nrow(candidates) > 0) {
      if (best_match) {
        # Find the best candidate by Spearman correlation of common sample intensities
        sample_cols_1 <- grep('area$', colnames(row1), value = TRUE)
        best_j <- NA
        best_score <- -Inf
        for (j in seq_len(nrow(candidates))) {
          sample_cols_2 <- grep('area$', colnames(candidates), value = TRUE)
          common_samples <- intersect(sample_cols_1, sample_cols_2)
          if (length(common_samples) > 1) {
            x <- as.numeric(row1[common_samples])
            y <- as.numeric(candidates[j, common_samples])
            score <- suppressWarnings(cor(x, y, method = "spearman", use = "pairwise.complete.obs"))
            if (!is.na(score) && score > best_score) {
              best_score <- score
              best_j <- j
            }
          }
        }
        if (!is.na(best_j)) {
          mz_batch_diff <- row1$mz - candidates[best_j, "mz"]
          rt_batch_diff <- row1$rt - candidates[best_j, "rt"]
          merged_row <- cbind(row1, candidates[best_j, ], mz_batch_diff = mz_batch_diff, rt_batch_diff = rt_batch_diff)
          aligned[[length(aligned) + 1]] <- merged_row
        }
      } else {
        # Keep all candidates
        for (j in seq_len(nrow(candidates))) {
          mz_batch_diff <- row1$mz - candidates[j, "mz"]
          rt_batch_diff <- row1$rt - candidates[j, "rt"]
          merged_row <- cbind(row1, candidates[j, ], mz_batch_diff = mz_batch_diff, rt_batch_diff = rt_batch_diff)
          aligned[[length(aligned) + 1]] <- merged_row
        }
      }
    }
  }
  do.call(rbind, aligned)
}

calc_stats <- function(peaktable, meta) {
  peaktable_with_meta <- peaktable %>%
    left_join(meta, by = c("File.name" = "File.name"))
  peaktable_with_meta %>%
    group_by(sample_type) %>%
    summarise(
      mean_intensity = mean(intensity, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd_intensity = sd(intensity, na.rm = TRUE),
      rsd_intensity = sd(intensity, na.rm = TRUE) / mean(intensity, na.rm = TRUE) * 100
    )
}
```

```{r align features}


# Merge all peaktable pairs (set best_match = FALSE to keep all candidates, or TRUE for best match only)
merged_peaktable_istd_pos <- align_features(peaktable_istd_pos_1, peaktable_istd_pos_2, best_match = TRUE)
merged_peaktable_istd_neg <- align_features(peaktable_istd_neg_1, peaktable_istd_neg_2, best_match = TRUE)
merged_peaktable_pos      <- align_features(peaktable_pos_1,      peaktable_pos_2,      best_match = TRUE)
merged_peaktable_neg      <- align_features(peaktable_neg_1,      peaktable_neg_2,      best_match = TRUE)

# Write merged tables to xlsx files in the output folder with original names

# Remove columns ending with .1 before export
remove_dot1_cols <- function(df) {
  df[, !grepl("\\.1$", colnames(df))]
}

openxlsx::write.xlsx(remove_dot1_cols(merged_peaktable_istd_pos), file.path(output_dir, "peaktable_istd_pos.xlsx"), overwrite = TRUE)
openxlsx::write.xlsx(remove_dot1_cols(merged_peaktable_istd_neg), file.path(output_dir, "peaktable_istd_neg.xlsx"), overwrite = TRUE)
openxlsx::write.xlsx(remove_dot1_cols(merged_peaktable_pos),      file.path(output_dir, "peaktable_pos.xlsx"),      overwrite = TRUE)
openxlsx::write.xlsx(remove_dot1_cols(merged_peaktable_neg),      file.path(output_dir, "peaktable_neg.xlsx"),      overwrite = TRUE)
```
